title: The church calendar: an event, opened
question: Three ways to show one event when it's tapped, text first, in the bulletin look. All three carry the same things: what and when, the place, Add to calendar, Register when there is one, what changed, the description, contacts for signed-in people, and the other dates of a regular event. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: A sheet over the week
options.lineage: the app's own sheets, as What's new uses them
options.thesis: Tapping an event raises a sheet over the calendar instead of leaving it: the essentials at once, the rest a pull up; the week stays where you were.
options.viewport: The week dimmed behind. The sheet: label and title, the when line with the regular event (every second Saturday), Add to calendar and Share, the change note in an orange-tinted box, then place and contact as facts; pulled up, the description and Other dates.
options.risk: A shared link or a notification opens the same sheet over the calendar, not a page of its own; a long description lives in a scrolling sheet.

options.label: The date block
options.lineage: the bulletin's dated notices, the day set large
options.thesis: A pushed page whose navy head carries a large tabular date block beside the title, so 'when' is read before anything else; a picture, when there is one, sits under the head.
materials: navy head with a date block
options.viewport: Back to This week. Navy head: SAT / 14 / NOV block and 8:30–11:30 beside the label and title. Under it Add to calendar and Share. The change note. Facts: place (opens maps), contact. About. Other dates.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three; with no picture it leans on the date block to be memorable.

options.label: Where first
options.lineage: the site map and the street directory
options.thesis: When an event has a place, the place leads: the site-map crop or a map of the address fills the top, the title and when sit over its foot, and Directions is the first action.
materials: navy band of title and time
options.viewport: A map of Teralba Park with a pin, the change note on it. A navy band: Outreach morning, Saturday 14 November, 8:30–11:30. Directions, Add to calendar. Facts and About under it.
options.risk: Events without a place (most regular ones) need a different top; a map of an outside address needs a map image source, which the app doesn't have yet.
